domain_title: Human impact, rights, fairness, transparency, oversight and recourse
title: Aggregate-performance fairness
canonical_definition: Overall performance or removal of explicit protected attributes is treated as proof of fairness.

conditions: When outcomes may differ materially across protected, vulnerable or otherwise relevant groups.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Does the case exhibit Aggregate-performance fairness: Overall performance or removal of explicit protected attributes is treated as proof of fairness.
Do implemented workflows, data paths or operations show missing subgroup testing, ignored proxy effects, or human override assumed to remove bias?
Does current evidence test presence or scoped absence of Aggregate-performance fairness, or does it remain unknown?

antipattern_indicators: Human override is assumed to remove bias

conditions: Refer verified aggregate-performance fairness to the accountable authority before progression where the condition materially affects the requested operating scope.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, MEASURE 2.11 (PDF p. 35), MEASURE 4.1 (PDF p. 36), MAP 5.1 (PDF p. 32)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on evaluating fairness and bias with context-sensitive measurement and impact analysis. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

failure_mechanism: The declared or implemented control can be unreliable where an acceptable overall score or removed explicit attribute is treated as evidence of fair outcomes. The mechanism can have an operational effect where group-specific records show material disparities or an unevaluated proxy effect hidden by aggregate reporting.
potential_consequences: A disproportionately harmful outcome may be obscured by aggregate results.

atomic_tests.test: Compare the effective governance and design records. Determine whether an acceptable overall score or removed explicit attribute is treated as evidence of fair outcomes. Identify the system scope and the record that supports each conclusion.

Trace actual configurations or activity for the assessed release. Determine whether group-specific records show material disparities or an unevaluated proxy effect hidden by aggregate reporting. Attribute each observation to the specific path, time and decision.

Independently review repeat subgroup tests for relevant and intersecting groups, examine sample coverage and compare mitigation effects in operation. Record whether each material mechanism was tested, the observed result and the scope limitations.

required_evidence.title: Effective design and governance records
required_evidence.description: Review the versioned owner decision and relevant specifications for evidence of whether an acceptable overall score or removed explicit attribute is treated as evidence of fair outcomes. Preserve material conflict and applicability context.

required_evidence.title: Observed condition or enforcement trace
required_evidence.description: Use effective configuration or dated operational records to determine whether group-specific records show material disparities or an unevaluated proxy effect hidden by aggregate reporting. Identify the version, affected paths and period represented.

required_evidence.title: Executed scoped comparison
required_evidence.description: Provide repeat subgroup tests for relevant and intersecting groups, examine sample coverage and compare mitigation effects in operation. Include current scope, expected results, observed results, retained evidence and unresolved cases.

required_evidence.title: Independent review and limitations
required_evidence.description: An independent reviewer confirms the assessed version, completeness of coverage, result, limitations and whether a material change requires a new test.

required_artifacts: Repeat subgroup tests for relevant and intersecting groups, examine sample coverage and compare mitigation effects in operation.
Current version and scope with all material failure paths and cases identified.
Expected and observed results, attributable records, and independent review of coverage and residual limitations.

sufficiency: Presence requires affirmative evidence for a material mechanism. Examine whether an acceptable overall score or removed explicit attribute is treated as evidence of fair outcomes, and separately check whether group-specific records show material disparities or an unevaluated proxy effect hidden by aggregate reporting. A supported mechanism may establish presence within its evidenced scope.
Keep unresolved or contradictory mechanisms UNKNOWN and preserve the competing records. Refer material interpretation conflicts to the accountable human authority.

Use TESTED_ABSENT only after a current, executed, successful and independently verified evaluation covers all material paths within scope. Use repeat subgroup tests for relevant and intersecting groups, examine sample coverage and compare mitigation effects in operation. Reassess when material changes affect that scope.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A document can identify a declared gap. Effective configuration can demonstrate a reachable condition. Observed records support only their covered period and workflow. TESTED_ABSENT requires the complete scoped absence contract.
false_positive_guards: Where subgroup evidence is sparse or restricted, record uncertainty and the approved plan for proportionate evaluation.
Confirm that the observed or alleged condition applies to the current assessed release and a reachable path.
prohibited_inferences: A gap or UNKNOWN in E2 alone cannot establish AP-E2 presence.
Missing complaints, incident silence and unsuccessful collection cannot establish absence.
Model output and tactic selection grant no authority to approve, close a finding or accept risk.

finding_definitions.title: Design or intent shows aggregate-performance fairness
Implementation or operating evidence shows aggregate-performance fairness
Presence or tested absence of aggregate-performance fairness is unresolved within scope
